brief:
A new rights group report concludes that Israel is systematically trying to "eliminate" living conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. The assessment suggests coordinated efforts targeting Palestinian infrastructure and services across the territory.

The report's findings point to conditions affecting Palestinian daily life, though specifics on which sectors or regions are most affected remain unclear from the initial assessment.
dek: Israel trying to 'eliminate' living conditions for Palestinians in occupied West Bank: Report Israel is systematically trying to "eliminate" living conditions for Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, according to a new report by a rights group.
title: Israel systematically undermining Palestinian living conditions in West Bank, report finds
